post.title: One AI bird finished the course. Three generations later, 69 did
post.caption: One AI bird finished all 22 pipes. Three generations later, 69 did. The best bird cleared 1 pipe in gen 1, 9 in gen 2, stayed stuck at 9 in gen 3, then gen 4 produced the first bird to clear all 22. Finishers went 1, 6, 49, 69. Each bird is a tiny neural network; the best ones get copied with small mutations every generation.
post.pinned: Each bird is a small neural network that decides when to flap. No one tells it how. The birds that fly farthest get copied with random mutations into the next generation.
post.notes: Seed 5965, maxsteps 1500. Per gen best pipes: 1,9,9,22,22,22,22; finishers (surv): 0,0,0,1,6,49,69. Gen 4 to gen 7 is three generations (7 - 4 = 3). Idea test: relatable/question/reaction/unrealistic = 3 of 4 (relatable, question, unrealistic).
